    line="${line#${line%%[!$'\t '\r\n']*}}"

    [[ "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    if [[ "$line" == export\ * ]]; then

      line="${line#export$'\t'}"

    [[ "$line" != *"="* ]] && continue

    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

    if [[ -z "${!key-}" ]]; then
      missing+=("$key")

  if (( ${#missing[@]} > 0 )); then

    printf '  - %s\n' "${missing[@]}" >&2
    echo "Set them in your environment before deploying." >&2
    exit 1
